ProductSvcCampaignDef.name: ProductSvcCampaignDef
ProductSvcCampaignDef.description: Represents information about the product or part that is impacted in a product service campaign. Stores the granular details related to product faults, facilitating efficient execution of the product service campaign.

BusinessBrandId.description: Auto-populated based on the business brand on the product record related to the product service campaign definition.

Description.description: The description of the product service campaign definition.

EndingSerialNumber.description: The serial number of the last impacted item in a serialized batch of items associated with a product service campaign.

ImpactedUnitCount.description: The actual number of units impacted of the product service campaign definition.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

MakeName.description: Auto-populated based on the make name on the product record related to the product service campaign definition.

ManufacturerLocationId.description: The location of the manufacturer associated with the product service campaign definition.

ModelName.description: Auto-populated based on the model name on the product record related to the product service campaign definition.

ModelYear.description: Auto-populated based on the model year on the product record related to the product service campaign definition.

Name.description: The name of the product service campaign definition.

ProductId.description: The impacted product of a product service campaign.

ProductSvcCampaignGrpDefId.description: The product service campaign group definition associated with the product service campaign definition.

ProductionEndDate.description: The date when a manufacturer ended production for a faulty product associated with a product service campaign.

ProductionStartDate.description: The date when a manufacturer began production for a faulty product associated with a product service campaign.

StartingSerialNumber.description: The serial number of the first impacted item in a serialized batch of items associated with a product service campaign.
